resources.string:
Zoom in and tap on a road to start defining a roadblock.

Pan the map and press the "+" button to add a new segment to the roadblock. Press the "✓" button when ready. To cancel the operation press the bottom left "x" button or the device's Back button.

You can always delete a roadblock by opening the roadblocks view via the top right button, or by tapping the corresponding roadblock icon on the map.
The action can not be undone.
The roadblock could not be defined. Make sure the target is placed on a road and try again.
You already have a defined roadblock with this name. Please choose another name.

The token you provided was rejected. Make sure you provide the correct value, or if you don\'t have a token, check the magiclane.com website, sign up or sign in and generate one. Then input it in the AndroidManifest.xml file.
This app requires Internet connection. Please connect to the Internet.
